$comment: Lane retirement for the aftersign red/green polarity gates (.github/workflows/redgreen.yml). THIS FILE is the source of truth (#1071/#727) - not grep-able marker strings in spec files. 'live' = the lane runs; 'retired' = the lane skips with a log line. Flip a lane here in the SAME PR that makes its spec ready (e.g. adding the FLAGSHIP_BREAK_MODE conditional guard). The workflow still fail-louds if a lane is marked live while its guard string is missing - config cannot silently un-guard a spec. NOTE (2026-08-11): durable-save.red seeded RETIRED — the FLAGSHIP_BREAK_MODE=local-only-save guard was removed when the durable contract went fully live in the main suite (the lane self-retired under the old marker logic); the fail-loud safety caught an initial bad seed that matched a comment. NOTE (2026-08-26, #1419): both red lanes kept RETIRED even though the FLAGSHIP_BREAK_MODE guards are now present in the specs. Reason: the break-mode implementations (local-only-save / drop-memory) no longer actually break the surface — server-authoritative save landed and the memory-drop path fell out of the runtime — so flipping either red to 'live' would trip the workflow's 'broken-polarity spec passed (exit 0)' fail-loud. The Path (b) scaffolding (guards + sentinel/describe.skip removal) is landed here so #1418's root-cause work can re-live these lanes with a one-line config flip once a real break-mode implementation is restored.
